title: Fix Joust graphical bug
description: Joust has a graphical rendering bug that needs investigation and fixing.

title: Map Tempest spinner input to mouse
description: Tempest spinner input should work with the mouse for natural control mapping.

title: Fix Tempest sound
description: Tempest sound output doesn't sound correct. Needs investigation and fixing.
close_reason: Fixed: POKEY channel output now latched at the channel underflow (commit a3dfd59) instead of sampling the polynomial at the 1.79 MHz master clock, which made all noise/distortion SFX harsh; plus the 1.79 MHz divider offset (AUDF+4 / AUDF16+7). Noise sounds now use the correct POKEY texture.

title: Motorola 68000 CPU emulator
description: Add a Motorola 68000 CPU emulator following the same structure as the 6809/6502/Z80 cores, architected so 68010/68020/(maybe)68030 variants can be layered on later via a variant field. Word bus model (Bus<Address=u32, Data=u16>), atomic (i8088-style) execution, TomHarte 680x0 SingleStepTests as the correctness gate. Design: docs/designs/m68000-emulator.md. This epic tracks M1 (foundation) as reviewable-sized child commits plus M2-M7 follow-ups.

title: m68000: CPU skeleton + registration
description: Create core/src/cpu/m68000/mod.rs: M68000 struct (d[8], a[8], usp, ssp, pc, sr, variant, exec temporaries) with #[derive(Saveable)] #[save_version(1)]; M68kVariant enum (M68000/10/20/30, only M68000 behavior); ExecState { Fetch, Execute(u32), Stopped, Halted }; stub execute_cycle + execute_instruction dispatch; BusMasterComponent/Cpu/CpuStateTrait/Debuggable/DebugCpu impls; Cpu::reset loads SSP from vector 0 and PC from vector 1. Add M68000State to core/src/cpu/state.rs (D0-7,A0-7,USP,SSP,PC,SR + debug_registers()). Register module in core/src/cpu/mod.rs (+ state re-export) and re-export M68000 in core/src/lib.rs. Builds, clippy+fmt clean.

title: m68000 M3: branches/jumps/subroutines
description: branch.rs: BRA/BSR/Bcc (disp8 + disp16), DBcc (Dn.w loop counter), JMP/JSR/RTS/RTR. Condition eval via flags::cc_true. Widen TomHarte skip-list. Tests: every cc, DBcc underflow, subroutine push/return.

title: m68000 M4: bit ops, MOVEM, LEA/PEA/LINK/UNLK
description: bit.rs: BTST/BSET/BCLR/BCHG (imm + Dn dynamic; bit mod 32 reg / mod 8 mem). stack.rs: LEA, PEA, LINK/UNLK, MOVEM (both directions, predecrement reversal), SWAP, EXG, ADDQ/SUBQ. Widen skip-list. Tests.

title: m68000 M5: exceptions/interrupts/privilege
description: exception.rs: vector dispatch, supervisor SP swap, 68000 short stack frame (gated on variant), TRAP/TRAPV/CHK/divide-by-zero/illegal/line-A/line-F/privilege/address-error, RTE, interrupt sampling at boundary + level masking + autovector, STOP/RESET. Tests: TRAP frame, RTE round-trip, privilege violation, odd-address error, interrupt masking.

title: m68000 M6: disassembler
description: core/src/cpu/m68000/disasm.rs: implement Disassemble + DebugCpu/Debuggable (model m6809/mod.rs:670-691). Tests core/tests/m68000_disasm_test.rs.

title: m68000 M7: full TomHarte coverage + optional MAME cross-validation
description: Widen TomHarte 680x0 skip-list to full coverage; resolve remaining diffs. Optional: MAME 68000 cross-validation shim under cross-validation/m68000_0148/ mirroring m6809 shim as a secondary oracle.

title: m68000: flags & SR model
description: core/src/cpu/m68000/flags.rs: SrFlag enum (X N Z V C in CCR low byte; I0-2 interrupt mask, S supervisor, T trace in system byte). Per-CPU set_flag/flag_is_set wrappers delegating to cpu::flags::set_flag. interrupt_mask()/set_interrupt_mask(). set_supervisor(on) swapping a[7] with usp/ssp on S-bit change. cc_true() condition-code evaluator for Bcc/Scc/DBcc. Document X-flag semantics. Unit tests for SP-swap and cc_true.

title: m68000: effective-address decoder
description: core/src/cpu/m68000/addressing.rs: Size { Byte, Word, Long }; Ea { DataReg, AddrReg, Mem, Imm }. read_imm_word (prefetch primitive); read/write byte/word/long over the word bus (byte write = RMW, word/long check addr&1 for address-error). decode_ea for all 12 modes (Dn, An, (An), (An)+, -(An), d16(An), d8(An,Xn), abs.w, abs.l, d16(PC), d8(PC,Xn), #imm) fetching extension words and computing 24-bit-masked addresses. ea_read/ea_write. Critical: (An)+/-(An) timing, A7-byte-adjusts-by-2, An word sign-extension, Dn byte/word preserves upper bits. Heavy unit tests.

title: m68000: word-bus systems & test buses
description: core/src/core/bus.rs: add bus_split! arm 'u32 word => dyn Bus<Address=u32,Data=u16>' and InterruptState.irq_level: u8 (default 0; fan out to explicit constructors). machines/src/simple_system.rs: SimpleSystem68k<C> (byte-addressable Vec<u8> storage serving u16 over even addrs + byte load helper) and Simple68000System alias. core/tests/common/mod.rs: TestBus68k (u32/u16). cpu-validation/src/lib.rs: TracingBus68k (u32/u16, byte storage) mirroring TracingBus20.

title: m68000: MOVE/MOVEA/MOVEQ + tests
description: core/src/cpu/m68000/move_ops.rs: MOVE.b/.w/.l (lines 0x1/0x2/0x3) all source/dest EA modes, MOVEA (.w sign-extends), MOVEQ (line 0x7, sign-extend 8->32, sets N/Z, clears V/C, X untouched). Wire dispatch in execute_instruction. Integration tests core/tests/m68000_move_test.rs covering every mode + MOVEQ sign-extension + flag behavior.

title: m68000: core ALU ADD/SUB/CMP + tests
description: core/src/cpu/m68000/alu/binary.rs: ADD/ADDA/ADDI/ADDQ-less core, SUB, CMP/CMPA/CMPI register + immediate forms, byte/word/long. Correct N/Z/V/C and X (ADD/SUB set X=C; CMP leaves X). Wire dispatch (lines 0x9/0xB/0xD + immediates on line 0x0). Integration tests core/tests/m68000_alu_test.rs: zero, sign boundary 0x7F/0x80, 0x7FFF/0x8000, 0x7FFFFFFF/0x80000000, carry/overflow, X-flag.

title: m68000: TomHarte 680x0 validation harness
description: cpu-validation/src/lib.rs: M68000TestCase/InitialState/Regs serde structs (D0-7,A0-7,USP,SSP,SR,PC,ram[(u32,u8)],prefetch). cpu-validation/tests/m68000_single_step_test.rs mirroring i8088_single_step_test.rs: load state, tick to boundary, compare final regs/RAM (state-only). should_skip list gating to M1 opcodes (MOVE/MOVEA/MOVEQ/ADD/SUB/CMP) so suite passes incrementally. Wire test_data/680x0/ download. Apply undefined-CCR mask.

title: m68000: README + roadmap checkbox
description: core/src/cpu/m68000/README.md: registers, M1 instruction set, opcode count, addressing modes, atomic-execution + word-bus-RMW caveats, resources (TomHarte, Motorola PRM). Update root README.md roadmap checkbox. Update opcode count.

title: m68000 M2: full integer ALU + unary + MUL/DIV/CHK + shifts
description: alu/binary.rs: ADDX/SUBX/ABCD/SBCD/NBCD/CMPM, ANDI/ORI/EORI, TST. alu/unary.rs: NEG/NEGX/NOT/CLR/EXT/Scc. alu/muldiv.rs: MULU/MULS/DIVU/DIVS/CHK (div-by-zero raise deferred to M5). alu/shift.rs: ASL/ASR/LSL/LSR/ROL/ROR/ROXL/ROXR (register count + memory single-bit). Widen TomHarte skip-list. Tests per group.
